In Christian tradition, this name holds a connection to the Virgin Mary and the Blessed Mother, representing a maternal and nurturing presence in one's life. The name Belldame also resonates with the idea of inner spirit and beauty, reflecting the philosophy of Proverbs 31:10 which states, "A good wife who can find? She is worth far more than rubies."
